newsitem.title: USA: Intercell seeks partners for Particle unit.
newsitem.headline: Intercell seeks partners for Particle unit.

text.p: Intercell Corp said Friday that it is discussing "strategic relationships with major corporations" in the U.S. and abroad for its Particle Interconnect subsidiary.
Intercell named companies in Japan, the Netherlands, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand and the U.S. as discussion partners for a possible alliance with Particle.

"The alliance is to get help to sell (Particle's) technology to larger companies," said a spokeswoman. She added Intercell's chief executive expected to reach an agreement before the end of this year.
Intercell's chief executive Paul Metzinger declined to comment on the specifics of a possible deal.

The company is trying to hire a replacement for Steven Clark, who resigned as president of the Particle subsidiary on May 13, the spokeswoman added. Intercell's chief operating oficer, Charles Bauer, is the acting chief executive of the subsidiary.
Intercell said Monday it named Paul Metzinger as chief executive to replace Gordon Sales, who resigned.
